workarounds.symptom: mcp-server-fetch: `fetch` prompt returns JSON-RPC error code 0 with the raw exception text for an invalid URL
workarounds.workaround: Fix: fix(fetch): reject an invalid prompt URL with -32602. Target files: src/fetch/src/mcp_server_fetch/server.py, src/fetch/tests/test_prompt_url.py, src/fetch/tests/test_protocol.py. The `fetch` prompt passed its `url` argument straight to httpx. A malformed URL such as `http://[::1` raises `httpx.InvalidURL`, which is not an `httpx.HTTPError`, so it escaped `fetch_url`'s handler and the prompt's `except ToolError`, and the SDK answered with its generic fallback for an unhandled exception. On current `v2/main` (aft... (Ref: https://github.com/modelcontextprotocol/servers/pull/5358)
